title: index.repo/v1 queue message
description: Pointer message published onto the `code_index` exchange (routing key `index.repo`) and consumed by the index consumer inside the worker process (SYSTEM_DESIGN.md §7.2, ADR 0001 §6.3). It only wakes the indexing job of one repository: the target commit lives on the `code_index_states` row and the job takes the latest one, so jobs of one repository merge. Carries no commit, archive or symbol data: the worker reads everything else from PostgreSQL and GitHub by `repository_id`.

Uuid.description: Lowercase, unprefixed UUID (application ids are plain uuid4, no prefixes). `format: uuid` documents intent; the pattern is what actually enforces the shape, since `format` is not asserted unless the validator opts in with a FormatChecker.

RequestedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a literal 'Z' offset. `format: date-time` is not asserted by the FormatChecker (needs the optional rfc3339-validator dependency, which is out of scope here), so this ASCII-digit pattern is what actually enforces the UTC-'Z' shape; it checks the shape only, not that the calendar date or time-of-day is valid.

message_id.description: Idempotency key of this wake-up: UUIDv5 of `repository_id:generation:requested_at`, so it is unique per wake-up, not per generation. JSON Schema cannot assert the derivation, so it is enforced by the producer, not by this schema.

repository_id.description: repositories.id whose index the job builds (code_index_states.repository_id).

generation.description: code_index_states.generation at publish time; a delivery for another generation is stale and is acked without a build.

attempt.description: 1-based number of the attempt of this wake-up, at most 3 (the retry budget); a new wake-up starts at 1.
